_comment: TEMPLATE for cvb-guard.config.json, the CVB (Claude Von Braun) PreToolUse bouncer. setup.mjs renders this by replacing the {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens with your real paths (lowercase, forward slashes) and writing cvb-guard.config.json next to it. CVB may write COORDINATION artifacts and NOTES, never DELIVERABLES, and never GOVERNANCE files. Tune behavior by editing the rendered file; no code changes needed. All path checks are case-insensitive and forward-slash-normalized, so entries must be lowercase; on Windows both the `c:/...` and the git-bash `/c/...` spelling of a path are listed.
_writeAllow: Paths CVB MAY Edit/Write regardless of file type. prefixes = startsWith; contains = substring; exact = full match.
_writeAllowRegex: Case-insensitive regex allow-patterns (matched against the normalized path). Covers CVB's own memory under any per-scope .claude/projects/<scope>/memory/ dir (his memory path varies by which chat he's in), and scratch/temp files anywhere (a staged brief or a captured command output is not a deliverable).
_notes: THE NOTES RULE. Beyond the coordination paths above, CVB may write NOTE-SHAPED files (plans, task files, analyses, research, briefs, captured output) anywhere under the roots below. Anything whose extension is NOT in noteExtensions is a deliverable by definition, which is what keeps him out of code (.ts/.tsx/.js/.html/.css/.py), images and binaries. The carve-outs below stop the notes rule swallowing work that belongs to a teammate or to the owner.
_noteDenyContains: Carve-out 1: directories where a note extension IS the deliverable. Markdown under a content/blog tree is Casey's article body, not a note. Anything under src/ is production, whatever its extension (a .json fixture or a .yml workflow is Devin's).
_noteDenyBasenames: Carve-out 2: config files that happen to wear a note extension. Writing package.json or firestore.rules is a production change, not note-taking.
_writeDeny: Carve-out 3 and the hard floor: governance files CVB may NEVER write, even if an allow rule or the notes rule would match. Changing personas or team rules needs the owner's go-ahead. basenames = exact filename; contains = substring (protects vault/team canon).
_bashDeny: Bash is default-ALLOW. Ordinary git writes (add/commit/merge/checkout/plain push), builds, pm2, and deploy scripts are ALLOWED; CVB runs commits and deployments for reviewed work. Still DENIED: git history surgery (rebase/reset/clean/cherry-pick/am/apply), force or delete pushes, amended commits, package publishing, image-gen python, and raw file mutation (rm/mv/cp). firstToken = the executable name of any command segment; regex = matched against each quote-stripped segment (case-insensitive).
